…#C236196003Elizabeth Báthory#CDEF.

Why torture others so much?
Why are you so hung up on youth?
Why are you so… idol?

Why, you ask?

I'm not hung up on it.
The more I reign them in, the more women weep.

"Women" are slaves, mothers, lovers, and

Peeking out of her mouth are irregular dragon teeth.

♪So gimme some of that

…
In spite of her mellifluous voice, her pitch is

Yep. Maybe there isn't a god in this world.
…what a sad Servant.
#C236196003Archer#CDEF shakes his head lightly.

No doubt.

Making us hear this perdition of a song,

A hoarse voice would be preferable at

#C236196003Caster#CDEF hangs her tail, realizing something.
Ah―me…… tone-deaf!?!?!?

? A gorilla… and a whale?
Gori… ale?
Goriale?

No encore!
A song where you sputter blood and die is no

#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF is unusually raring to go…!

"G-Golden P."?
Wh-what the… What a Gorgeous name.

Yes, of course, #C236196003Rani#CDEF.
I'll take the rest off your hands.

Ha―――Ghh―――!
A little pain… like this―――
No, I won't give in to any pain―――!

…remember this.
I'm an immortal, ageless, eternal, supreme idol.

I WILL return, and I'll drag you,
#[pig][squirrel]#, straight down to hell…!

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF. There's only one way to

No, for me, this is where the show starts.

I am #C236196003Rani #RUBSEighth#RUBEVIII#REND#CDEF.
Earth's last and perfect homunculus created by
alchemists.
…is she sure about that?

You'll go *pop*. *squeeze*. *squoosh*. *squish*.
…like that. Just come touch me, gently…

However, they also serve to expose the
emotions and addictions that normally control a person.

Since #C236196003Rani#CDEF's have all been exposed,

…hmph.

When two people's opinions differ, the one
with the least legitimacy must bear the shame.
I-is that so…?

Therefore, please do as I say.
Promise me this, and I'll release you.
…now I see.

I'm not talking about strength.
It's my intellect that far exceeds yours…

Will entrust all the chaos of the world to me,
the mother computer; big brother.
Ah, no…!
What #C236196003Rani#CDEF calls "objective" means "what I think."
"Logical" means "this is what I like."
#C236196003Rani#CDEF likes to have everything go her way.
I'm also… not weari―
Anyone can tell that I'm lying, so why is #C236196003Rani#CDEF so delighted?

…! Ah―I'm just acknowledging that
you've finally understood that I'm rational!
―――Damn! Did I phrase it wrong!?
A "perverted exhibitionist"…!
Hyah…!

I mean… I'm superior to human beings… see?
What I feel to be pleasurable,
is intense and correct…

Now I'm going to prove it beyond any doubt…
Let's play a game, #[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF.
Cheat Gamer
Damn, I was wrong…

HAAaaAA…!
No! It's a lie―――
Ahh, but it feels good―――

My third eye has opened at last, my mentor…
Humanity must dress lighter―MUCH lighter.

First, I need to correct that mistake she's made.
I harden my heart and say―――

Wonderful… Thank you for your approval.
I finally got my ideas across to you…
Damn! That's not hardening my heart…!
KyaaAaaa!
But it's the truth.
And anyway, #C236196003Rani#CDEF is also a Master.
You're… not wrong to conclude that―――
No, "frustration" is no pointless emotion.
It leads to a mind that grows and self-reflects.
I feel hot, cold, good…

Could this be…
what it feels like to like something…?
No, that's not allowed…

And yet, why…
is this so breezy…?
What do I do…?
I like #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
I like it breezy.

…no. You no longer have any chances.
I'm now firmly set.
The world is growing dark…

…now there's no way out.

For a second there, I was thinking about

…these are the depths of #C236196003Rani#CDEF's mind?

Still, it's too dark. There's a sensation of
people bustling around, but our surroundings
are shut out by the darkness.

So you're here.
You arrived on time―as I calculated.

Only #C236196003Rani#CDEF stands within the darkness.
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF doesn't appear to be here.

Only #C236196003Rani#CDEF, huh? Where did that #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
crawl off to? No, before that answer―what is
the nature of this darkness?

Whether it's executing the apprehended Masters,
or this darkness; none of it is the sort you
would do.

Can't see #C236196003Lancer#CDEF anywhere…
As for this darkness, it's way too inefficient
to be a trap. It's unlike you, #C236196003Rani VIII#CDEF.

It's just #C236196003Rani#CDEF…? There aren't any
sacrifices gathered here, nor is that
#C236196003lizard woman#CDEF spewing out her silly voice.

I'd figured the moment Darling bests you,
you'd pressure us through sheer numbers, but…
#C236196003Rani#CDEF, have your tenets changed?

You're the one who values efficiency.
I had hoped that you had underlings enough
to blanket this ground, but…

Really, now. A boring reception, #C236196003Rani VIII#CDEF.
#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF may be a mongrel, but in #[his][her]# own
way has pluck. You, all alone, won't do.

…quite true. My normal self would've deployed
hostile programs about the Relief, protecting
it against interlopers.

However―――
I wanted #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF to come here,
at any cost.

I gave #C236196003Lancer#CDEF that stage so that she
wouldn't let you get away.

The chances of you avoiding our confrontation
were slim, but worst cases do happen.

If you knew the Masters would be sacrificed,
then you would assuredly come.
Historical data indicated such.

Still, I can't believe that #C236196003Rani#CDEF would treat
#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF with such hostility.

Y-yes. Hearing such does not altogether
displease us.

…however, I'm understanding less and less.
What was it that induced your ire?

She's GRATEFUL for having her #C000246204SG#CDEF extracted…
I want #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF to learn from her ability
to calmly admit her own faults…

However, I can't make heads or tails of this.
My Master here IS inconsiderate,
but what exactly offended you?

Oh? Happy about having your secrets aired out?
So you're THAT kind of girl, huh, #C236196003Rani#CDEF?
Well, let's put that aside…

You're being a little inconsistent. Just what
in the world incited your pride as a woman of
science so much?

Hmph. Even if a mind were armed, all that would
await is anguish. If she herself is fine with
that, then I'll stay my advice.

However, what's the reason behind this darkness?
Tenebrous and chilled, like the bottom of a
dried-up well, and filled with grudges.

[#C000246204Powergamer#CDEF] or some such――I'll never accept
such a dishonorable classification. Now I feel
strongly enough that one of us must die.
We see things differently.

Come on, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF was the one who named you that, anyway!
I had nothing to do with it!

I invited you in here because those that
enter can't leave without my permission.

Now, she'll be undertaking your execution.
―――Apologies for the wait, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.
As promised, it's your turn.

Okay! Leave it to me, Producer!
Just as you wish, I'll give every last one of
them some good jabbings.

Go, throw all the lights on me!
The Blood Countess #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF makes her
appearance!

Hmhm. Nice reaction, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
Your face, frozen with fear…
That's the #[piggy][squirrely]# we know and love.

I'll mix you into my bloodbath, too. Won't you 
prostrate yourself before the fangs of a noble
dragon girl, #C236196003Elizabeth Báthory#CDEF?

…she said it.
She declared it outright.

#C236196003Elizabeth Báthory#CDEF…!
I know that name! From the vampire novella,
Carmilla!

The bloodsucker woman of Čachtice castle…!
But what is she thinking, revealing her
own True Name…!?

So, it was you. A #RUBS        original basis #RUBEvampire model#REND on par
with Dracula. The paragon of a woman
obsessed with delusions of eternal youth.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF's surprise is warranted.
To Servants, their True Name is something they
keep a perfect secret until the very end.

What the intentions are of someone boldly announcing it to their
enemy is something I can't wrap my head around…!

#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF isn't perturbed in the slightest,
but I can't conceal my own surprise.

To Servants, their True Name is something they
keep a perfect secret until the very end.

What the intentions are of someone boldly announcing it to their
enemy is something I can't wrap my head around…!

Intentions?
I don't have any intentions for cattle.
All you are is a sacrifice.

To be squandered for my, the ruler's, benefit…
Isn't that what all cattle hope and dream for?

That's why, have yourself a gory death.
Your blood and anguish becomes my youth,
nourishment for my world-resounding voice!

A mass murderer who seized her vassals and killed them,
bathing in their blood to improve her youth.

But―――no matter how I look at it,
doesn't there seem to be a ton of
discrepancies between her and her legend…?

*kgh*… Again with that #[napping piggy][lost squirrely]#-like
expression―――No, bear with it, #C236196003Eliza#CDEF.
There are things to do before the killing.

This is my final mercy, #[piggy][squirrely]#.
Since you're making that face,
I'll let you ask me one question.

Rid yourself of all your regret. See, it's
hard to enjoy a sacrifice's blood if they still
have regrets. Death will relieve all stress.

For a tremendously egotistical reason,
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF forced me to ask a question.

…it's annoying to play along with the enemy,
but this is a rare chance.
I ask―――

Torture is a #RUBS human's#RUBEnoble's#REND duty. To rule and control
the masses, to stabilize their lives is the
reason I exist.

Torture is the ultimate management system for
pigs, squirrels, and rabbits―so my father told
me. I'm in agreement.

For you all, the masses, torture itself is
proof that you're alive; it's the joy of your
lives, isn't it?

It's inexplicable otherwise!
You all chirp about freedom, freedom―when
you're controlled at last, you grow fat!

That's on you all, no?
There's nothing bad about my torture.
Nothing bad about it AT ALL!

―――Well aren't you an idiot.
You really are a pig. You dumb pig!
Is being cute all you're good for!?

Are you really asking that?
Hey, are you REALLY asking that? You may be a
squirrel, but you're a girl too, right?

The whole world around me, and all of these
so-called "men," are FORCING me to be the most
beautiful woman in the world!

Yes. I'll meet their desire. I'll become an
eternally young, beautiful idol. I'll bathe
in your blood, for eternity!

Idol!
Ahh, it has the most wonderful ring to it!

I want to ask YOU something. You're all just
pigs, so how did you imagine up such
a wonderful occupation?

I have no interest in #RUBS    Mongoloids#RUBEyellow races#REND, but I have
to admit that, as far as the entertainment
industry goes, the Japanese are good stock.

Thinking about it, I was miserable while I was
alive. I knew of nothing in life but torture.
I suffered headaches from the boredom.

But I became a Servant, and through
the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF learned of Japanese idols…
It was like getting hit so hard you see stars.

It's idols, you know, idols! Perfection!
Their job is to go only after cute things and
be fawned over!? What!?

What is this if not a calling? When they stand
on stage and perform a song, it's the best!
Ah, enough to forget who I am!

That's right―――
The more beautiful I become, the more men
splendidly cry out.

"Men" are beings who serve, support, and are
sometimes adorable. In short, they're pigs―

Understand? The point is that idols themselves
are the ultimate torture! I'm going to take
over the entire business world!

Intoxicated by her own words, #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF is gleeful.
She doesn't consider her egotistical claims
to be crimes in the slightest.

…#C236196003Lancer#CDEF. It's not like I don't #RUBSsympathize with#RUBEunderstand#REND
what you're saying. Statesmen must sometimes
be tyrannical.

The more citizens there are, the more I must
use force on them lest they stray. But――
your words seem to go a little too far.

You done spewing your cruel words? Of course
you'd turn into a monster. At what point did
you consider yourself not to be human?

…*sigh*. Now we're finally near the end. She's
what the word "hopeless" means. That person
really can't see anyone but herself.

That's right, thanks for understanding! In
spite of you being a fossilized fox-ears,
you're seeing things from my point of view!

What's wrong? You're quiet all of a sudden.
Have you realized how terrifying I am and
gotten cold feet NOW?

Oh my, you have some promise, I see. Props to
the veteran, we see eye to eye. You may be my
enemy, but you're cute―totally my type.

You've got it all wrong, all wrong.
It's not that I'm not human, it's that all
of you aren't human.

Isn't that right, Mr. Nobody, #C000246204Nameless
Heroic Spirit#CDEF? You all have no need
for individuality!

Well, one becomes undesirable after 18,
so it'd be offensive not to think this way.
Hehe. So desperate, trying to look young.

A lizard has noooo right to say that!
I'll kill her! I was stupid to sympathize
with her in the slightest!

But too bad. I'll roast you slowly like I do
with geese. I'll skewer you and your Master,
and float you around in my bathtub!

――――Hmph. I thought perhaps you were a
deviant who knew true pleasure; but in reality,
you're as you appear to be: a little girl.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, fight as you will. My displeasure
is immeasurable, so I'll leave this to you. Her
singing is the only thing to partake in.

Done talking?
Then it's time for my last song.

Though you may be cattle, you live to resign
your lives for the benefit of my beauty.
Accept this finest of prizes.

This is the never-before-heard Dragon Countess's
melody――Offering your life wouldn't suffice!
The goddess' song which fills the #ROFS-003#RUBS    sky#RUBEheavens#REND!

♪Love like a Dracul
   (Not a morning person) so you be nice to me
    I tend to wake up late after one o'clock

♪Such an empty belly   is how I live my life
   (A piece of toast just isn't enough)
♪  Hunting's so magical
♪  So many heads to cull
♪  From my Čachtice Castle
♪  Special delivery just for you

♪   So don't fret, 'cuz you'll get
     locked up tight鷙 tonight

*kgh*! An incredibly beautiful, demonic
composition…! Praetor, don't give her your
ear! She'll steal your heart in an instant!

………
#C236196003Saber#CDEF, what did you just say?

…and it's no wonder why. I can't believe such
a mellifluous voice is being absolutely wasted.
It's torturous…

…and it's no wonder why. I can't believe such
a mellifluous voice is being wasted…!

―――Okay. I've changed my mind, mongrel.
I said I wouldn't interest myself in this, but
I'm willing to kill her―and posthaste.

If that was the one and only worthwhile song,
then she must now die. No, death is too lenient.
As Golden P., I'll re-coach her from scratch!

…and it's no wonder why.
A mellifluous voice like that being absolutely
wasted is such a crying shame;
it makes my chest tighten up, like this!

Agh! Is she a demon!? Even I mistook this for a
composition of the heavens! Guh, I have a
feeling that my rival just made her debut…!

Heh. That's what I should be saying, #C236196003Saber#CDEF.
I saw right through you at first sight and
knew you were a terrific singer.

My word…!
This is it, Praetor!
"Great minds think alike," as they say!

It would be more appropriate to say
"birds of a feather flock together" in THIS situation.

The silver lining is, it didn't seem to be an
attack strategy. A real miracle. With any less
luck, we could've been knocked out instantly.

If that plan had been executed,
we'd probably be dead on our backs right about now.

………it appears that you all aren't
capable of understanding my song.

Fine. Before I squeeze the blood out of you,
first I'll make you understand my song!

We'll earnestly excuse ourselves from that.
Any dialogue we have now won't help us reach
an understanding, musically or otherwise.

…see, I've always been around lots of people
who were good at singing, so I can't take
someone so tone-deaf.

What ELSE could you be!?
You're a weapon of acoustic destruction!

I was foolish to call you a lizard.
You've got a calamitous, gorilla-whale fusion
monster level of tone-deafness!

…the heck is that? It sounds kind of cute…
You've got good sense for an old lady―imagine
that. Those fox ears are good for something.

Alright. As a reward, I'll sing the second song
for you! Be moved by my song, moved to spit
your blood out and die!

Darling! In order to protect nature on Earth,
let's defeat this woman here and now!
To hell with you!

And you can see his ghastly,
nouveau riche look from a mile away…
I wonder if he's some BIG promoter… *gulp*
